prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Back or Create Your Pet Account", "Sign in to keep your pet save state safely synced across your devices.", "Select your account method to preserve existing pet profiles.", "Continue with Account"]
1: ["Sign In First to Save Progress", "Secure your profile so your pet and customizations are always preserved."]
2: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Use clear lighting and clear angles for best 3D pet generation results.", "Review Pet Generation Quality", "Checking image lighting and framing to ensure your pet renders correctly on your desktop.", "Confirm & Continue"]
3: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially registered! Name your companion to finalize adoption.", "Verified Pet Parent Certificate"]
4: ["Generating 3D model mesh and desktop animations..."]
5: ["You can safely minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!"]
6: ["Desktop Display Verification", "Testing desktop overlay permissions and pet screen positioning.", "Verify Desktop Render"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready and exploring your desktop screen right now!", "Start Interacting", "Your companion will wander around your screen. Click or right-click anytime to interact!"]
8: ["Your Pet is Active!", "Right-click your pet on screen or click the tray icon to chat, customize, hide, or open settings."]
9: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Select 'Instant Pet' to choose from ready-made companions, or 'Custom Pet' to generate a companion from your own pet photos.", "Continue"]
